name: China
hook: The Great Wall, the Terracotta Army, and a skyline built overnight
description: Three cities, three very different Chinas — Beijing's imperial past and hutong alleys, Xi'an's buried army of ten thousand, and Shanghai's neon-lit Pudong skyline across the Bund.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~15–18hr via one connection, usually Istanbul, Addis Ababa, or Dubai
quickFacts.climate: Continental and dry in the north, humid and subtropical in Shanghai
